versions.content: When a call to an Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyStartOfRe- ception API exists within an Rte_LdComCbkStartOfReception callback, the RTE shall pass through the following IN parameters from the outer callback function context as parameters to the Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyStartOfReception call: • info • TpSduLength The variables passed to the Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyStartOfReception shall be unchanged from the parameters passed to the Rte_LdComCbkStartOfRe- ception callback.
